svg.text: Everything entered into a calendar is stored in Nextcloud. ClubGear keeps a rebuildable cache — no second master copy.
Each calendar maps to one CalDAV collection
Local mode remains available for installations that run without Nextcloud — it is not a second copy of a Nextcloud calendar.
The VEVENT is the record — including who is registered
None of it is authoritative calendar data
Derived from CalDAV, discardable, rebuilt on demand.

By design there is no local fallback copy. If
Nextcloud is unavailable, the calendar is
read-only from cache and writes fail with a

Attendee names and addresses live in the
